name: AmbientCG Browser (Blender extension)
summary: Unofficial Blender 4.2+ extension that searches ambientCG's CC0 materials and HDRIs from the 3D Viewport sidebar (N panel). Pick 1K-16K and JPG/PNG, then 'Add Material' builds the full PBR node setup (color, roughness, normal, height, AO, metal, opacity, emission) on selected objects, or 'Set World HDRI' with strength/rotation. Downloads are cached and work offline; no account or API key.

access.notes: Unofficial, not affiliated with ambientCG. Assets fetched are ambientCG CC0. Needs Blender online access to search/download.

procedure: In Blender 4.2+, open Edit > Preferences > Get Extensions > Repositories > + > Add Remote Repository.
Paste https://jsiovn.github.io/ambientcg-browser/index.json, tick Check for Updates on Startup, click Create.
Search 'AmbientCG Browser' in Get Extensions and click Install (or drag the zip button from the page onto Blender).
In the 3D Viewport press N, open the AmbientCG tab, search, choose resolution, then Add Material or Set World HDRI.

verdict.why: Puts ambientCG's whole CC0 material/HDRI library one click away inside Blender with proper PBR node setup and offline cache; installs via an official Blender extension repository so it auto-updates. Minus: very new (2 stars), unofficial.
